'''Steven Turner''' (also published as '''Stephen Turner''') posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1998.<ref name="list-62767">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/62767.html? swccg-discussion message #62767], [[Steven Turner]] (1998).
